name: GSC
summary: **GSC** is a [[kind:cultivar|cultivar]] bred by Jigga of the Cookies Fam in Northern California in the early 2010s. Most accounts describe it as a cross of [[og-kush|OG Kush]] and [[durban-poison|Durban Poison]], sometimes with [[cherry-pie|Cherry Pie]] in the mix, though Jigga has said those stories were put out to deter copying. Rapper Berner later built the Cookies brand around it.

sources.title: GSC / Girl Scout Cookies strain page
Who's Got the Real Cookies?
sources.note: Credits Jigga as breeder and places its emergence in the Mendocino region; other accounts say the Bay Area. Quotes Jigga calling the OG Kush/Durban Poison story a decoy.
